milestones.title: Slash commands as plugin components
evidence: AC1: `claude plugin validate . --strict` exits 0 ('Validation passed') with the four commands present; captured in .dogwatch/evidence/M02-validate.txt (first run failed on unquoted argument-hint YAML in two files, fixed by quoting).

AC2: `claude --plugin-dir . plugin details dogwatch` exits 0 and lists all four commands (dogwatch-init, dogwatch-report, dogwatch-status, dogwatch-supervise) by name in its component inventory; captured in .dogwatch/evidence/M02-details.txt. Bare `plugin details` needs an installed plugin, so loading the repo from disk via the top-level --plugin-dir is the closest inventory command that works here.

AC3: src/plugin-commands.test.ts has one passing subtest per command asserting presence + description frontmatter (ok 22-25) plus 'no command hands the model a path the supervisor is denied' (ok 26); deliberate break (removed dogwatch-report.md) produced 'not ok 25 ... commands/dogwatch-report.md is missing' and '# fail 2', restore returned '# pass 81 # fail 0'. Counts in .dogwatch/evidence/M02-test.txt.

AC4: docs/DECISIONS.md carries D-018 'Four slash commands ship; run, serve, and the human-only commands do not (2026-08-19)', naming the four shipped commands and each rejected command (run, serve, unblock, steer, kill, attend, skill install) with its reason.
AC5: npm run typecheck exit 0, npm test exit 0 (81 pass, 0 fail, up from 76), npm run build exit 0; counts in .dogwatch/evidence/M02-test.txt. Committed cf55cc8 and tagged v04-plugin/M02.
